name: Graph Cut Equivalence
description: Replaced the original "Archive Footprint" (size of union of incident edges) with "Boundary Size" (number of edges with exactly one endpoint in the selected set, i.e., the cut size). The condition that the sum of degrees equals the cut size is mathematically equivalent to the independent set condition (since cut size = sum of degrees - 2 * internal edges). This shifts the semantic framing from set union to graph cuts, disrupting surface pattern matching while allowing a completely rigorous, step-by-step equivalence derivation to satisfy the gate.
